  • I completed Introduction to Business Finance with Alison in October 2025, with credential ID 3998-36834668. The course covered the history and principles of business finance and introduced investment analysis tools. It added a financial perspective to the organisational questions I had already begun exploring through business administration.
  • When reading about a company or investment, I want to ask what the business is trying to achieve and which assumptions support the decision. What is expected to create value? Which uncertainties might change the outcome? What information would a reader need before reaching a stronger conclusion?
  • Administration and finance let me look at a business from two connected angles: how it works and how it makes decisions about value and resources. I want to become more comfortable explaining that connection in plain language. When I cannot explain something clearly, it helps me see what I need to investigate next.

01 / 04

An introduction to the financial perspective

I completed Introduction to Business Finance with Alison in October 2025, with credential ID 3998-36834668.

The course covered the history and principles of business finance and introduced investment analysis tools. It added a financial perspective to the organisational questions I had already begun exploring through business administration.

The connection

Finance interests me because a business decision has assumptions behind it.

Read the deeper context+

What is expected to create value? What could change the outcome? How does the decision fit the organisation's purpose? Those questions help me read about a transaction with more attention to its reasoning, instead of stopping at the headline.

02 / 04

Questions beyond a headline

When reading about a company or investment, I want to ask what the business is trying to achieve and which assumptions support the decision.

What is expected to create value? Which uncertainties might change the outcome? What information would a reader need before reaching a stronger conclusion?

The connection

M&A and private equity are the areas I particularly want to explore.

Read the deeper context+

I am curious about how commercial, financial, and legal perspectives come together, and how people deal with uncertainty. I am still building that understanding, beginning with introductory learning and a more careful approach to reading about businesses.

03 / 04

Building a useful foundation

Administration and finance let me look at a business from two connected angles: how it works and how it makes decisions about value and resources.

I want to become more comfortable explaining that connection in plain language. When I cannot explain something clearly, it helps me see what I need to investigate next.

The connection

I would like to follow one public business development over time, beginning with the company's stated aim and watching what happens afterwards.

Read the deeper context+

Which assumptions become clearer? Which questions remain? That would give me a practical way to develop my reading and connect introductory finance ideas to an actual commercial story.
